info.headline: Minor Flood Warning for Bunyip River, Bunyip River at Iona and Bunyip River at Cora Lynn
info.description:
Minor flooding is likely at Cora Lynn and possible at Iona.
The Bunyip River at Iona is currently at 1.18 m and steady, below the minor flood level. The Bunyip River at Iona may peak around the minor flood level (2.10 m) from early Sunday morning.
The Bunyip River at Cora Lynn is currently at 2.28 m and steady, below the minor flood level. The Bunyip River at Cora Lynn is likely to reach around the minor flood level (3.10 m) from Sunday morning.
info.instruction:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous. * Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways. * Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads. * Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay informed. * For local emergency management warnings and advice visit www.emergency.vic.gov.au.
For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.
